title: Modbus Mapping -- Expose Data to an HMI / App
concept:
To let an HMI, SCADA, or app read/write your PLC over Modbus TCP, you MAP tags
onto Modbus objects. Four object types:

    Coils            (0xxxx) - read/write bits   (commands)
    Discrete Inputs  (1xxxx) - read-only bits    (status)
    Holding Registers(4xxxx) - read/write 16-bit (setpoints)
    Input Registers  (3xxxx) - read-only 16-bit  (measurements)

You stage internal tags into the mapped tags each scan:

    MB_Cmd_Run   := System_Run;   (* coil            *)
    MB_Sts_Fault := Fault;        (* discrete input  *)
    MB_HR_Setpt  := Setpoint;     (* holding register*)
ab_note: Micro800/Logix expose Modbus TCP via the Ethernet port config or MSG instructions; you assign tags to Modbus addresses in the mapping.
siemens_note: S7-1200/1500 use the MB_SERVER (slave) / MB_CLIENT FBs; the HMI reads the mapped holding registers. Same idea: internal tag -> Modbus address.
task:
Stage three internal tags onto their Modbus-mapped tags so an app can see them:
  - MB_Cmd_Run   := System_Run   (coil / command)
  - MB_Sts_Fault := Fault        (discrete input / status)
  - MB_HR_Setpt  := Setpoint     (holding register / setpoint)
